graph.title: LEGO 40199 Billund Airport

edges.method: clear cheese slope attached sideways onto the side stud of the 1x1 brick with stud on 1 side
1x2 grooved tile attached sideways onto the side stud of the first 1x1 side-stud brick
1x2 grooved tile attached sideways onto the side stud of the second 1x1 side-stud brick
horizontal clip of the red 1x1 plate clipped onto the white bar (flag on flagpole)

notes: Total 286 pieces (b1-b286); every type/colour count matches the parts list.
Fix applied: b233 (1x1 dark green plate) now rests on a single piece (b68), since a 1x1 piece can only clutch one stud cell. All other 1x1 pieces already rested on a single piece.

Steps are recorded in booklet order. 2x/4x/5x sub-assemblies are listed copy by copy: the four 'unit' towers of step 19 (b110-b133), the two stacks each in steps 23, 25, 26, 40, and the five aeroplanes of step 50 (b262-b286).

Base: four black 6x12 plates side by side (b1, b7, b10, b13) with a ring of black grooved tiles; the border tiles overhang and clutch the next plate, so they list both plates; plates added later list [] because nothing is under them.
Position is null for every piece, as required.
Rows of tiles/plates on the baseplate (steps 9-16) list the 6x12 plates they cover; the exact stud columns were estimated from the isometric pictures.

Step 19 unit stacking (clear 1x1 plate + white brick, clear 1x2 plate, grey 1x2 plate with tile, curved brick) and the central roof build-up (steps 23-42) were interpreted from small drawings; where a drawing was ambiguous the closest plausible supporting piece(s) were chosen.
Grey-looking 1x2 / 1x1 plates in the drawings were assigned to Trans-Clear so that counts match the parts list (30 clear 1x2, 15 clear 1x1).
Cheese slopes: step 22 and 34 (one) and 40 are Light Bluish Gray; steps 27, 33, 34, 38, 39 and the five aeroplane cockpits are Trans-Clear; step 41 and two plane tails are White.
Planes (step 50): white 1x3 plate sits on a jumper stud, coloured 1x2 plate on it, tail slope and a white 1x3 tile on the coloured plate, clear slope on the free end of the 1x3 plate.
Flag pole: the white Bar 3L stands in the green plate at the garden corner; the red clip plate clips on to it (other_join). The bar's exact mounting stud is assumed.

Pieces with rests_on [] other than the first plate (b7, b10, b13 base plates slid under overhanging tiles; b170 clear slope and b187 tile and b256 clip plate attached sideways) are intentional: they clutch nothing underneath and are connected through other_joins or via the tiles above.
